name: 映像ノイズ一貫性解析
description: Examines noise pattern consistency across frame regions
algorithm: Video Noise Consistency — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes video noise consistency for forensic detection:

1. **ノイズ推定**: Per-region noise level and noise characteristics are estimated from each frame using smooth-region analysis and noise estimation algorithms. The noise model (Gaussian, Poisson, mixed) and parameters (variance, spatial correlation) are determined.

2. **ノイズ空間的一貫性**: Camera noise should be spatially consistent — same sensor, same noise for all regions at a given signal level. The method compares noise characteristics between face and background. Deepfake composites show noise mismatches — the generated face has different noise (from the generator) than the captured background (from the camera sensor).

3. **ノイズ-信号Relationship**: Camera noise follows specific noise-signal relationships: photon shot noise creates variance proportional to signal. The method checks this relationship across the frame. AI-generated content may show incorrect noise-signal dependencies — either constant noise (additive model) or noise patterns that don't follow physical sensor models.

4. **ノイズスペクトルShape**: Camera sensor noise has specific spatial frequency characteristics determined by the anti-aliasing filter and readout electronics. The method analyzes noise power spectral density — AI generators produce noise with different spectral characteristics than camera sensors.

5. **時間的ノイズ分析**: Frame-to-frame noise should be independently distributed (uncorrelated). The method checks temporal noise independence — AI-generated frames may show correlated noise patterns (repeated noise structures between frames or systematically evolving noise) inconsistent with camera capture.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 統計
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 noise consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
